admission.justification: End-to-end deterministic, read-only, fail-closed upstream auditing and pre-leaf freshness triage require immutable audit models, read-only Git/file collection, Lean lexical scanning, atomic status emission, read-only ancestry triage and deterministic CLI exit-code wiring to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-audit or rh-check-upstream against read-only upstream checkouts reproduces byte-identical, timestamp-free provenance.json and verification-status.json without executing Lean or leaving partial writes on error, surfaces any solution forbidden token via exit code 1 alongside honest artifacts, and classifies upstream ancestry and replay drift deterministically with exit codes 0, 10, 11 and 2.
title: Phase 0 deterministic upstream audit and freshness-triage pipeline
